subtitle: Modern Pantry Design
summary: A modern, linear pantry with warm-lit glass cabinets.

texts.heading: Design Concept
texts.body: A modern, linear pantry from CREO Italian Kitchens that combines refined Italian craftsmanship with contemporary functionality. A sleek, integrated wall solution that provides generous storage, a practical preparation zone, and elegant display through warm-lit glass cabinets.

items: Handleless design with integrated finger-pull grooves
Discreet black metal fittings and accessories (rails, shelves)

texts.heading: Worktop & Splashback
items: Durable, non-porous, heat and stain resistant
